QUOTE: "`token_hits` | Which token emptied the conjunction. Every token must appear in one searchable unit. | No. It says the term is missing from the searched units, not from the repo." and "A multi-token miss: this only shows the conjunction failed. Drop the token that matched nothing and retry before concluding anything."

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer discusses zero-result signals and not-looked-there scope, but it never says that a single token matching nothing was previously treated as proof of absence. It describes the current behavior, not the earlier flaw that conflated "nothing exists" with "I did not look there."
